facts.business: Vasundhara Rasayans Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and export of finished goods, with operations involving capital expenditure and foreign currency risk management.
key_risks: Foreign currency risk from capital expenditure and exports
Interest rate risk on short-term borrowings
Commodity price risk from raw material and energy cost fluctuations
Credit risk with three major clients representing 80% of receivables as of March 31, 2023
Liquidity risk in meeting obligations on time
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties were on arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions were made that may have a potential conflict with the interest of the company. Prior omnibus approval of the Audit Committee is obtained for foreseeable and repetitive transactions. Details are provided in Form AOC-2 annexed as Annexure-III.
